About ITC Immunity Therapy Center - Alternative Cancer Treatment in Tijuana
Alternative Cancer Treatment at ITC Immunity Therapy Center Navigating a cancer diagnosis can be overwhelming, prompting many individuals to explore innovative care pathways beyond standard protocols. Seeking Alternative Cancer Treatment in Tijuana, Mexico allows individuals to access customized medical modalities designed to stimulate the immune system and target malignant cells. For individuals researching a cancer treatment clinic abroad, ITC provides compassionate, evidence-informed medical programs tailored to each individual's unique biological profile, medical history, and overall stage of diagnosis. Request a Consultation With ITC Immunity Therapy Center Share your medical information and receive guidance about available treatment options. Recent Reviews
This was my husbands 5th trip to ITC. He goes annually for check-ups and to get an "immune boost"! He is always treated like family and gets quality care. We are happy with all aspects of ITC but above all we are happy with the results of his treatments!
Jana C
The ITC doctors, nurses, and staff were absolutely phenomenal. I was given specialized and personalized care not only for the three weeks I received therapy at their facility, but also in the months that followed as I continued home therapy. These people are in the business of caring for those with sickness and they do it with compassion and wisdom. Their confidence is encouraging and I have seen a complete turn around in my health.
Chris P
Beyond my wildest dreams would I have imagined receiving the enormous Hospitality and medical service at ITC.. from airport pickup to customer service , front desk, nutrition , personal doctor, personal nurse , orientation ,all on a daily basis. I congratulate Medical Director, Dr. Carlos Batista and his extraordinary staff for providing a healing process for cancer beyond the highest standards in Alternative Medicine… I am extremely grateful that the Lord provided and guided my path to this Medical Institution…

blocks.heading: Recent Reviews
blocks.text: This was my husbands 5th trip to ITC. He goes annually for check-ups and to get an "immune boost"! He is always treated like family and gets quality care. We are happy with all aspects of ITC but above all we are happy with the results of his treatments!

blocks.heading: Jana C
blocks.text: The ITC doctors, nurses, and staff were absolutely phenomenal. I was given specialized and personalized care not only for the three weeks I received therapy at their facility, but also in the months that followed as I continued home therapy. These people are in the business of caring for those with sickness and they do it with compassion and wisdom. Their confidence is encouraging and I have seen a complete turn around in my health.

blocks.heading: Chris P
blocks.text: Beyond my wildest dreams would I have imagined receiving the enormous Hospitality and medical service at ITC.. from airport pickup to customer service , front desk, nutrition , personal doctor, personal nurse , orientation ,all on a daily basis. I congratulate Medical Director, Dr. Carlos Batista and his extraordinary staff for providing a healing process for cancer beyond the highest standards in Alternative Medicine… I am extremely grateful that the Lord provided and guided my path to this Medical Institution…
